UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated player profile with customizable nickname and lifetime Impostor game stats.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

impostorRounds.description: Total rounds played as an impostor.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

GameRoom.title: GameRoom
GameRoom.description: Cross-device multiplayer Impostor game room state, player roster, turn timer metadata, and voting state.

roomCode.description: 6-character uppercase alphanumeric room code matching document ID.

hostId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

status.description: Current lifecycle phase of the room.

impostorCount.description: Number of impostors chosen by the host.

turnDurationSeconds.description: Length of each player's turn in seconds.

currentRound.description: Current round number starting at 0 in lobby.

category.description: Current round word category shown at upper side of word box.

genre.description: Current round word genre shown below the word box.

hint.description: Clue close to the secret word shown in red for impostors and green for normals.

memberUids.description: List of Firebase Auth UIDs currently in the room.

playerNames.description: Map of UID to player nickname.

playerScores.description: Map of UID to cumulative score.

turnOrder.description: Ordered list of UIDs for timed speaking turns.

currentTurnIndex.description: Index of active player in turnOrder.

turnStartedAt.description: Server timestamp when current turn started.

timerPaused.description: Whether the turn timer is currently paused.

readyUids.description: UIDs of players who confirmed viewing their role card.

votes.description: Map of voter UID to suspect UID.

hintsEnabled.description: Whether 1-word hints are enabled by host.

categoryCluesEnabled.description: Whether Category and Genre labels are enabled by host.

timerEnabled.description: Whether turn countdown timer is enabled by host.

impostorAbilityEnabled.description: Whether one impostor receives the Ultimate Agent Killer vote-voiding ability.

saviorAgentEnabled.description: Whether one regular agent receives the Savior Agent protection shield ability.

agentDirectorEnabled.description: Whether one regular agent receives the Agent Director double-vote ability.

agentPredictionEnabled.description: Whether agents may optionally predict an impostor while viewing words.

revealedWord.description: Populated only when status transitions to RESULTS.

revealedImpostorUids.description: Populated only when status transitions to RESULTS.

revealedKillerUid.description: UID of the Ultimate Agent Killer revealed at RESULTS.

revealedNullifiedVoterUid.description: UID of the player whose vote was voided by Ultimate Agent Killer, revealed at RESULTS.

revealedSaviorUid.description: UID of the Savior Agent revealed at RESULTS.

revealedProtectedUid.description: UID of the player protected by the Savior Agent revealed at RESULTS.

revealedSaviorSaved.description: Whether the Savior Agent successfully shielded the impostor's kill target.

revealedDirectorUid.description: UID of the Agent Director whose vote counted twice revealed at RESULTS.

revealedPredictions.description: Map of agent UID to predicted impostor UID revealed at RESULTS.

revealedRoundDeltas.description: Map of player UID to round score delta revealed at RESULTS.

impostorGuess.description: Word guess submitted by an impostor.

impostorGuessBy.description: UID of the player who submitted the impostor guess.

impostorGuessCorrect.description: Whether the impostor word guess matched the secret word.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when room was last updated.

PlayerAssignment.title: PlayerAssignment
PlayerAssignment.description: Private per-player role assignment document storing whether the player is IMPOSTOR or NORMAL and the secret word for normals.

secretWord.description: Secret word for NORMAL players; empty string for IMPOSTOR.

category.description: Category displayed at the upper side of the word box.

genre.description: Genre displayed below the word box.

hint.description: Hint close to the secret word.

ultimateKiller.description: True for the single impostor granted the Ultimate Agent Killer ability this round.

savior.description: True for the regular agent granted the Savior Agent shield ability this round.

director.description: True for the regular agent granted the Agent Director double-vote ability this round.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when assignment was written.

HostRoundSecret.title: HostRoundSecret
HostRoundSecret.description: Host-only round secret holding the secret word, impostor UIDs, and ultimate killer UID for result evaluation.

impostorUids.description: UIDs of impostors for the active round.

ultimateKillerUid.description: UID of the single impostor with Ultimate Agent Killer ability.

saviorUid.description: UID of the regular agent with Savior Agent ability.

directorUid.description: UID of the regular agent with Agent Director ability.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when secret was written.

SecretRoundAction.title: SecretRoundAction
SecretRoundAction.description: Private per-player round ability/prediction choice readable by owner or by host at reveal.

killedVoterUid.description: Target player UID whose vote is nullified by Ultimate Agent Killer.

protectedPlayerUid.description: Target player UID given a protection shield by Savior Agent.

predictedImpostorUid.description: Predicted impostor UID chosen by an Agent, or empty if skipped.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when action was updated.

/rooms/{roomCode}/assignments/{playerUid.description: Private per-player role and secret word assignments readable only by that player.

/rooms/{roomCode}/hostSecrets/{secretId}.description: Host-only active round secret word and impostor list.

/rooms/{roomCode}/secretActions/{playerU.description: Private per-player killer target and agent prediction choices.
